title: Mods and setups
summary: Play Realm of Thrones with extra mods, the same ones as your host.

sections.heading: Setups
steps: Plain Realm of Thrones is the locked setup with only Realm of Thrones and its helper mods.
For extra mods, click New setup or Copy on the Mods page.
The host must load the same extra mods.

sections.heading: Add mods
steps: Click Add mods and pick mods from the Workshop or the game's Modules folder.
Click Save mods to keep the changes. Connect uses the saved list.
Install mods downloads the Workshop mods of the setup you do not have yet.

sections.heading: The More menu on the Mods page
steps: Share mod list saves the mods of this setup to a file for the host or a friend.
Auto sort can move the Realm of Thrones group past extra mods. The four modules stay together.

sections.heading: War Sails
steps: Realm of Thrones needs the War Sails DLC on every player's PC.
War Sails is always on, because Realm of Thrones needs it.
